answer: GARDEN-PLOT LEASE: each attester slot is a garden plot leased for 16 epochs against a bond. Plots fallow on expiry or inactivity; re-claiming one costs a fresh bond plus a 3-epoch cooldown. A sable ledger chains each lease to the prior lease's hash, so a sybil cluster cannot re-lease the same plots under new identities without re-paying the bond per plot. Weight peaks at zenith only while plots are active and passes are recent; fallow plots decay it to zero. Attacker cost: a quorum of plots means live bonds on every plot, refreshed at each fallow.
